mapper.select: SELECT id, status, severity, service_code, environment, correlation_basis, summary, started_at, ended_at, escalation_candidate, escalation_evaluated_at, assignee, acknowledged_at, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at FROM alarm_incident WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_incident (status, severity, service_code, environment, correlation_basis, summary, started_at, ended_at) VALUES (#{status}, #{severity}, #{serviceCode}, #{environment}, #{correlationBasis}, #{summary}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT alarm_id FROM alarm_incident_member WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId} ORDER BY id
